verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter runs a secure client portal where documents are uploaded and reviewed, so asking whether a client can export their case data and leave is a fair question. However, the evidence never documents any bulk export, open-format download, or offboarding process. Uploading and reviewing documents in the portal is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
